narrative.overview: Six real video thumbnails, concrete tasks, and concise results in the established paper/navy/green identity. A local-workflow outline explains Markdown and SQLite FTS5. Plans and exact evidence stay behind native disclosures. The header theme utility follows system preference and remembers an explicit choice.
dos: Do pair each video with one concrete task and short useful result.
Do keep exact source quotes and required limitations available.
Do make the next action obvious and singular.
donts: Don't restore the source sidebar, mode tabs, repeated marketing sections, or inline command catalog.
Don't remove provenance labels to achieve a smaller word count.
